source: paper/main.tex working copy of 2026-10-09 20:50 (re-scored for the implrel100s1_e088 model and mosaic): Tables 1, 3 and 4, abstract, Sections 3.1-3.3. The manuscript still calls the product MADER; the website uses the new name MESA.

metrics.deployMAE: Median of the per-DEM mean absolute error of the product as delivered. Shifts, offsets, and tilts were not removed.
metrics.labelMAE: Error after the prediction is rescaled to the mean and standard deviation of the reference, after co-registration. Reported for MESA. MOLA is evaluated as distributed (deployMAE).
metrics.sub_km_r: Correlation with the reference at wavelengths below ~1 km.

product.title: The product
rows: 18 m, simple cylindrical on the Mars sphere (R = 3,396,190 m), 1,185,494 × 592,747 pixels
45,570 CTX images, 2006–2025, one prediction per image and tile (53,702)
MOLA areoid, leveled to MOLA PEDR laser shots: median residual −0.05 m, robust SD 2.28 m
96.4% predicted from CTX images and 3.6% infilled (1.4% within 30° of the equator, 11.2% poleward of 60°). Data are available equatorward of ~88.6° latitude.
Provenance mask (CTX-derived or infilled), per-pixel expected error, and uncertainty class.
Fine-scale amplitude is low (39% of the HiRISE amplitude below 144 m). The improvement over MOLA is small poleward of 80°. Infilled areas are suitable for context and unsuitable for morphometry.
